tldr: Self-hosted modular monolith: FastAPI, PostgreSQL, React/Vite/TS/Tailwind, Hebrew-first RTL.
An invitation is both the RSVP unit and the seating party; one set_rsvp function serves guests and admins.
WhatsApp is deferred behind a messaging provider interface; a test provider exports CSV.
Seating uses a dnd-kit canvas, an OR-Tools solver, locks and snapshots.
Seven roadmap phases, each demoable with seed data.
